exercises.exerciseTitle: Recognizing Shared Cyrillic Capital 'М'
exercises.prompt: Identify the Cyrillic letter that represents the bilabial nasal consonant /m/ (equivalent in visual shape to Latin 'M').
exercises.hint: Look for the letter identical in form to the English uppercase 'M'.

options.text: М
options.explanation: Correct! Cyrillic 'М' represents /m/ and shares its glyph form with Latin 'M'.

options.text: И
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'И' represents the vowel /i/, which looks like a reversed 'N'.

options.text: П
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'П' represents the voiceless stop /p/ (Greek Pi).

options.text: Л
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Л' represents the lateral liquid /l/.

exercises.correctAnswer: М
exercises.explanation: Cyrillic uppercase 'М' and lowercase 'м' represent the voiced bilabial nasal consonant /m/. It is visually identical to Latin 'M'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! You correctly recognized Cyrillic 'М'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember, Cyrillic 'М' looks identical to the Latin letter 'M'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Modern Mongolian Cyrillic shares several glyphs directly with Latin: A, O, M, T, K. Consonant 'М' corresponds to the universal bilabial nasal phoneme [m].

audio.speechSynthesisText: М

exercises.exerciseTitle: Matching Lowercase and Uppercase Shared Consonants
exercises.prompt: Pair each uppercase Cyrillic letter with its exact lowercase partner for the shared letters Т, К, О, А.
exercises.hint: Cyrillic lowercase letters generally mirror their uppercase shapes in reduced height.

options.text: Т -> т
options.explanation: Т matches lowercase т.

options.text: К -> к
options.explanation: К matches lowercase к.

options.text: О -> о
options.explanation: О matches lowercase о.

options.text: А -> а
options.explanation: А matches lowercase а.

exercises.correctAnswer: Т-т, К-к, О-о, А-а
exercises.explanation: In printed Cyrillic, letters like Т, К, О, and А have identical letterforms in uppercase and lowercase, varying only in font size.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! All case pairings match correctly.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Check each letter: Т-т, К-к, О-о, А-а.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Unlike Latin handwriting where cursive 't' differs substantially from 'T', Mongolian Cyrillic print preserves the uniform bar top for both uppercase Т and lowercase т.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Т, К, О, А

exercises.exerciseTitle: Distinguishing True Consonant 'К' in Loanwords
exercises.prompt: Which of the following common Mongolian loanwords begins with the shared Cyrillic consonant 'К'?
exercises.hint: Think of the international word for cinema / movie.

options.text: кино (cinema / movie)
options.explanation: Correct! 'кино' begins with Cyrillic 'к'.

options.text: ном (book)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'ном' begins with 'н'.

options.text: гэр (home / yurta)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'гэр' begins with 'г'.

options.text: ус (water)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'ус' begins with vowel 'у'.

exercises.correctAnswer: кино
exercises.explanation: Cyrillic 'К' appears predominantly in international loanwords in Mongolian such as 'кино' (movie), 'карт' (card), and 'кофе' (coffee).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'кино' is spelled with initial Cyrillic 'к'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: 'кино' starts with 'к'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Native Mongolian vocabulary uses 'г' and 'х' for velar and uvular stops/fricatives. The letter 'к' was introduced into the Cyrillic orthography primarily to accommodate 20th-century Russian and international loan vocabulary.

audio.speechSynthesisText: кино
audio.ipaTranscription: /kʲinɔ/

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'тамга' assembled perfectly.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Follow the sequence: т -> а -> м -> г -> а.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Тамга' is a historical and cultural term designating sovereign stamps, clan seals, and brand marks throughout Central Asia.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Auditory Minimal Pair Contrast: О vs Ө
exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio recording. Did the speaker pronounce back rounded vowel word 'мод' (tree/wood) or front rounded vowel word 'мөр' (shoulder/path)?
exercises.hint: Notice whether the vowel resonance sounds deep and guttural (О) or mid-front and rounded (Ө).

options.text: мөр (shoulder / line / path)
options.explanation: Correct! The speaker pronounced the front rounded vowel /ө/ in 'мөр'.

options.text: мод (wood / tree)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'мод' contains the back rounded vowel /ɔ/.

exercises.correctAnswer: мөр
exercises.explanation: Cyrillic 'Ө' represents the front mid-rounded vowel /ө/ [ɵ], contrasting with 'О' which represents the back low-mid rounded vowel [ɔ].

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! You distinguished the front vowel 'ө' in 'мөр'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Listen to the tongue position: 'ө' is higher and forward compared to 'о'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The phonemic contrast between back /ɔ/ and front /ө/ is fundamental to Khalkha phonology and governs root vowel harmony throughout the language.

audio.speechSynthesisText: мөр
audio.ipaTranscription: /mɵr/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Auditory Discrimination: High Back 'У' vs High Front 'Ү'
exercises.prompt: Listen carefully to the audio stimulus. Which word was spoken: 'ус' (water) or 'үс' (hair)?
exercises.hint: The back vowel 'у' has a pharyngeal resonance /ʊ/, while 'ү' is a front close vowel /u/.

options.text: ус (water) - Back vowel У
options.explanation: Correct! The audio features the retracted back vowel /ʊ/ in 'ус'.

options.text: үс (hair) - Front vowel Ү
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'үс' has a higher, fronted vowel quality /u/.

exercises.correctAnswer: ус
exercises.explanation: Mongolian 'ус' (/ʊs/) uses the back rounded vowel У, whereas 'үс' (/us/) uses the front close rounded vowel Ү.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! That was 'ус' (water) with back vowel У.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The spoken token has a deeper back tongue position: 'ус'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: In Mongolian linguistic terminology, 'у' belongs to the masculine vowels (эр эгшиг), while 'ү' belongs to the feminine vowels (эм эгшиг). Conflating them changes word meaning completely.

audio.speechSynthesisText: ус
audio.ipaTranscription: /ʊs/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Phonetic Categorization: Sorting Spoken Roots by Vowel Backness
exercises.prompt: Listen to the word: 'сүү' (milk). Does it contain a Front (feminine) vowel or a Back (masculine) vowel?
exercises.hint: The letter 'ү' is written with a vertical tick through the center and sounds like high front /u/.

options.text: Front (Эм эгшиг) - vowel Ү
options.explanation: Correct! 'сүү' features the long front rounded vowel үү.

options.text: Back (Эр эгшиг) - vowel У
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'сүү' contains front vowel ү, not back vowel у.

exercises.correctAnswer: Front (Эм эгшиг) - vowel Ү
exercises.explanation: 'Сүү' (milk) is formed with the long front vowel 'үү', placing it squarely in the feminine (front) harmonic class.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'Сүү' is an exemplary front-vowel root.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: 'ү' belongs to the front (эм) vowel class.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Long vowels in Mongolian are orthographically represented by double letters (аа, ээ, оо, өө, уу, үүү). Their harmonic class matches their single counterpart.

audio.speechSynthesisText: сүү
audio.ipaTranscription: /suː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Minimal Pair Dictation: Өдөр vs Үнэн
exercises.prompt: Listen to the word meaning 'day' and type the Cyrillic spelling using the front vowel Ө:
exercises.hint: Transcribe the mid-front rounded vowel 'ө' followed by alveolar stop 'д' and coda 'р'.
exercises.correctAnswer: өдөр
exercises.explanation: 'Өдөр' (/өдөр/ [ɵtər]) means 'day'. It exemplifies harmonic assimilation where both vowels are mid-front 'ө'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Гайхалтай! You spelled 'өдөр' with exact Cyrillic letters.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember that the word for 'day' has front rounded vowels: 'өдөр'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Non-initial vowels in Khalkha Mongolian undergo reduction, but orthography preserves the harmonic front vowel symbol 'ө'.

audio.speechSynthesisText: өдөр
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɵtər/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Auditory Identification: Detecting the Odd Vowel Out
exercises.prompt: Three of these words contain back vowels (эр эгшиг). Which word contains a FRONT vowel (эм эгшиг)?
exercises.hint: Listen for the unrounded front vowel 'э'.

options.text: гэр (home) - vowel Э
options.explanation: Correct! 'гэр' contains the front vowel 'э'.

options.text: ус (water) - vowel У
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'ус' contains the back vowel 'у'.

options.text: сум (arrow/district) - vowel У
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'сум' contains back vowel 'у'.

options.text: нут (homeland root) - vowel У
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'нут' contains back vowel 'у'.

exercises.correctAnswer: гэр (home) - vowel Э
exercises.explanation: 'Гэр' contains 'э', a front unrounded vowel. The other three words contain 'у', a back rounded vowel.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! 'Гэр' is the front-vowel word.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'гэр' has 'э' which is front; the others have 'у' which is back.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Front vowels in Mongolian are: э, ө, ү (and front variants of и). Back vowels are: а, о, у.

audio.speechSynthesisText: ус, сум, нут, гэр
audio.ipaTranscription: /ʊs, sʊm, nʊtʰ, ɡer/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Categorizing Core Roots: Masculine vs Feminine
exercises.prompt: Select the correct harmonic classification for the root word 'гал' (fire).
exercises.hint: The vowel 'а' is a masculine back vowel.

options.text: Masculine / Back (Эр үг) - vowel А
options.explanation: Correct! 'гал' contains 'а', making it an 'эр үг' (masculine back-vowel word).

options.text: Feminine / Front (Эм үг) - vowel Э
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'гал' does not have front vowels.

exercises.correctAnswer: Masculine / Back (Эр үг) - vowel А
exercises.explanation: Because 'гал' contains the low back vowel 'а', it is classified as a masculine word (эр үг) and will take back-vowel suffixes (e.g. гал-аас, гал-ын).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'Гал' is an эр үг.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'а' is a back masculine vowel, so 'гал' is an эр үг.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Vowel harmony (эгшиг зохицох ёс) is the golden rule of Mongolian morphology: back-vowel roots only take back-vowel suffixes, and front-vowel roots only take front-vowel suffixes.

audio.speechSynthesisText: гал
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɢaɮ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Identifying Feminine (Эм) Root Words
exercises.prompt: Select ALL words below that belong to the FEMININE / FRONT vowel class (эм үг):
exercises.hint: Look for words containing э, ө, or ү.

options.text: гэр (home / yurta)
options.explanation: Correct: 'гэр' contains front vowel 'э'.

options.text: өвөл (winter)
options.explanation: Correct: 'өвөл' contains front vowel 'ө'.

options.text: ном (book)
options.explanation: Incorrect: 'ном' contains back vowel 'о'.

options.text: ус (water)
options.explanation: Incorrect: 'ус' contains back vowel 'у'.

exercises.correctAnswer: гэр, өвөл
exercises.explanation: Both 'гэр' (vowel э) and 'өвөл' (vowel ө) are feminine front-vowel words (эм үг). 'Ном' and 'ус' contain back masculine vowels.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'гэр' and 'өвөл' are both feminine words.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Check the vowels: 'э' and 'ө' are feminine; 'о' and 'у' are masculine.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Feminine words take front harmonic suffix allomorphs such as -ээр/-өөр/-үүр, while masculine words take -аар/-оор/-уур.

audio.speechSynthesisText: гэр, өвөл
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɡer, ɵwɵɮ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Detecting Harmonic Violations in Nonce Words
exercises.prompt: Which of the following hypothetical word roots VIOLATES Mongolian vowel harmony rules by mixing masculine and feminine vowels?
exercises.hint: A single native root cannot contain both 'а' (masculine) and 'э' (feminine).

options.text: *мадэ (contains masculine 'а' and feminine 'э')
options.explanation: Correct! Mixing back 'а' with front 'э' in a single stem is strictly prohibited by vowel harmony.

options.text: малгай (all back vowels: а, а, ай)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'малгай' is fully harmonic (masculine).

options.text: нөхөр (all front rounded vowels: ө)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'нөхөр' is fully harmonic (feminine).

options.text: охин (neutral 'и' with back 'о')
options.explanation: Incorrect. The neutral vowel 'и' can freely occur with back vowels.

exercises.correctAnswer: *мадэ (contains masculine 'а' and feminine 'э')
exercises.explanation: Native Mongolian roots maintain strict vowel harmony: back vowels (а, о, у) never co-occur with front vowels (э, ө, ү). Therefore, '*мадэ' is impossible.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! '*мадэ' illegally mixes back 'а' and front 'э'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: Masculine and feminine vowels can never mix in a native root.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The only exception to pure harmonic separation is the neutral vowel 'и', which may appear in both masculine and feminine words without changing the dominant gender of the root.

audio.speechSynthesisText: малгай, нөхөр, охин
audio.ipaTranscription: /maɮɢæ, nɵxɵr, ɔxʲiŋ/

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Masculine (нар, сар) then feminine (гэр, сүү).
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Group by vowel: нар & сар are masculine; гэр & сүү are feminine.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: In Mongolian poetry and cosmology, 'нар сар' (sun and moon) are paired masculine celestial symbols, while 'гэр орон' anchors domestic life.

audio.speechSynthesisText: нар, сар, гэр, сүү

exercises.exerciseTitle: Auditory Identification of Root Gender Harmony
exercises.prompt: Listen to the word 'морь' (horse). Because it contains vowel 'о' with palatalized 'рь', what suffix set will it take?
exercises.hint: 'О' is a back masculine vowel with labial rounding.

options.text: Masculine suffixes with back harmony (e.g. -оор/-ын: мориор)
options.explanation: Correct! The root vowel 'о' dictates masculine rounded suffix harmony.

options.text: Feminine suffixes with front harmony (e.g. -ээр)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'О' is never feminine.

exercises.correctAnswer: Masculine suffixes with back harmony (e.g. -оор/-ын: мориор)
exercises.explanation: 'Морь' (/mɔrʲ/) has root vowel 'о'. The soft sign indicates palatalization of 'р', but the dominant vowel is 'о', demanding back masculine suffixes.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! 'Морь' takes masculine suffixes such as 'мориор'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The primary vowel is 'о', which is masculine.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Palatalization (зөөлний тэмдэг ь) affects consonant articulation but does not alter the fundamental back/front harmonic classification of the root vowel.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Assembling Canonical SOV Word Order
exercises.prompt: Arrange the scrambled word tokens into a grammatically correct Mongolian declarative sentence: 'I will read a book'.
exercises.correctAnswer: би ном уншина
exercises.hint: In Mongolian, the subject comes first, the direct object comes second, and the verb always stands at the end.
exercises.explanation: Mongolian is strictly head-final with canonical Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) order. 'Би' (Subject) precedes 'ном' (Object), and 'уншина' (Verb) must terminate the clause.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! You placed the verb at the clause-final anchor.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: Subject (Би) + Object (ном) + Verb (уншина).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Modern Mongolian strictly prohibits English-style SVO ordering (*Би уншина ном). The finite predicate holds the absolute right edge of the sentence.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Би ном уншина.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰi nɔm ʊŋʃən/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Locating the Finite Predicate Slot
exercises.prompt: In the sentence 'Багш маргааш сургууль дээр ирнэ' (The teacher will come to school tomorrow), which word occupies the finite predicate slot?
exercises.hint: Look at the final word of the sentence that conveys the action/tense.

options.text: ирнэ (will come) - Clause-final verb
options.explanation: Correct! 'Ирнэ' is the finite verb in clause-final position.

options.text: багш (teacher) - Subject
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Багш' is the subject in initial position.

options.text: маргааш (tomorrow) - Temporal adverbial
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Маргааш' is a temporal modifier.

options.text: сургууль дээр (at school) - Locative adverbial
options.explanation: Incorrect. This is a postpositional locative phrase.

exercises.correctAnswer: ирнэ (will come) - Clause-final verb
exercises.explanation: The finite verb 'ирнэ' (comes/will come) concludes the clause, serving as the syntactic head to which all preceding arguments link.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! 'Ирнэ' is the predicate.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The predicate in Mongolian is the verb at the very end: 'ирнэ'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Because Mongolian is head-final, modifiers (temporal, locative, direct objects) always precede the verb head, and attributive adjectives precede the noun head.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Багш маргааш сургууль дээр ирнэ.
audio.ipaTranscription: /paɢʃ marɢaːʃ sʊrɢʊːɮ ter irən/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Head-Final Modifier Placement (Adjective + Noun)
exercises.prompt: Which phrase correctly demonstrates the rule that demonstratives and descriptive adjectives must precede the head noun?
exercises.hint: Demonstrative ('this') + Adjective ('big') + Noun ('ger').

options.text: Энэ том гэр (This big ger)
options.explanation: Correct! Demonstrative 'Энэ' + Adjective 'том' + Head noun 'гэр'.

options.text: *Гэр том энэ
options.explanation: Incorrect. Placing the noun before its modifiers violates head-final structure.

options.text: *Том гэр энэ
options.explanation: Incorrect. The demonstrative 'энэ' must precede the adjective.

options.text: *Гэр энэ том
options.explanation: Incorrect. Unnatural word order.

exercises.correctAnswer: Энэ том гэр (This big ger)
exercises.explanation: In Mongolian noun phrases, the hierarchy is strictly Demonstrative -> Adjective -> Head Noun ('Энэ том гэр').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! Modifiers always precede the noun in Mongolian.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: Demonstrative first, adjective second, noun last (Энэ том гэр).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Unlike Romance languages where adjectives often follow the noun, Mongolic syntax requires all attributes to branch to the left of their head noun.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Энэ том гэр
audio.ipaTranscription: /en tʰɔm ɡer/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Assembling Complex Clause with Temporal & Locative Arguments
exercises.prompt: Reconstruct the scrambled words into a standard sentence: 'Dorj will arrive in the city today'.
exercises.correctAnswer: Дорж өнөөдөр хотод ирнэ
exercises.hint: Subject (Дорж) -> Time (өнөөдөр) -> Location (хотод) -> Verb (ирнэ).
exercises.explanation: Standard neutral Mongolian order is Subject + Temporal Adverbial + Locative Adverbial + Verb: 'Дорж өнөөдөр хотод ирнэ'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Perfect clause architecture.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Follow the sequence: Дорж -> өнөөдөр -> хотод -> ирнэ.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Time expressions may optionally topicalize to the very front ('Өнөөдөр Дорж хотод ирнэ'), but the verb 'ирнэ' must unconditionally remain at the end.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Дорж өнөөдөр хотод ирнэ.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tɔrtʃ ɵnɵːtər xɔtʰət irən/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Syntax Error Spotting: SVO Transfer Interference
exercises.prompt: A foreign learner wrote: '*Би ууна цай' (attempting to say 'I drink tea'). What is the error and how should it be corrected?
exercises.hint: The direct object 'цай' must come before the verb 'ууна'.

options.text: The verb 'ууна' was placed before the object; it should be 'Би цай ууна'.
options.explanation: Correct! English SVO was incorrectly transferred. Mongolian requires SOV: Би цай ууна.

options.text: The pronoun 'Би' is missing an accusative suffix.
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Би' is the subject, correctly in the nominative.

options.text: 'Цай' is a loanword and cannot take an object position.
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Цай' is perfectly normal native vocabulary.

exercises.correctAnswer: The verb 'ууна' was placed before the object; it should be 'Би цай ууна'.
acceptableAlternatives: The verb 'ууна' was placed before the object
exercises.explanation: In English, verbs precede their objects (I drink tea), but in Mongolian, the object must precede the verb: 'Би цай ууна'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! SVO must be converted to SOV: 'Би цай ууна'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Mongolian always puts the object before the verb: Би цай ууна.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Diurnal Greeting Matching: Time of Day to Salutation
exercises.prompt: It is 09:00 AM and you arrive at a Mongolian corporate office. What is the appropriate formal greeting?
exercises.hint: 'Өглөө' means morning.

options.text: Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе! (Good morning!)
options.explanation: Correct! 'Өглөөний мэнд' is the polite greeting for the morning hours.

options.text: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе! (Good afternoon!)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Өдрийн мэнд' is used around midday and afternoon (12:00-17:00).

options.text: Оройн мэнд хүргэе! (Good evening!)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Оройн мэнд' is used in the evening (after 18:00).

options.text: Сайхан амраарай! (Have a good rest / Good night!)
options.explanation: Incorrect. This is a parting wish before sleeping.

exercises.correctAnswer: Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе! (Good morning!)
exercises.explanation: 'Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе' (literally: 'I deliver the peace/wellbeing of the morning') is the standard formal greeting before noon.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе' is used in the morning.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: At 09:00 AM use 'Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The greeting uses the genitive form of the time noun (өглөө -> өглөөний, өдөр -> өдрийн, орой -> оройн) modifying 'мэнд' (wellbeing), followed optionally by the performative verb 'хүргэе' (let me convey).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе!
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɵɡɮɵːniː mentʰ xʊrɡiː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Formal Reciprocal Greeting Response
exercises.prompt: A senior colleague greets you at 14:00 with: 'Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе!'. How should you respectfully reply?
exercises.hint: Echo the diurnal greeting and add a respectful inquiry about their wellbeing using 'Та'.

options.text: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу? (Good afternoon, are you well?)
options.cyrillic: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу?
options.explanation: Correct! Echoing the time-specific greeting with the formal honorific inquiry 'та сайн байна уу?' is the polite gold standard.

options.text: За, юу байна? (Yeah, what's up?)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Юу байна' is informal slang inappropriate with senior colleagues.

options.text: Баяртай, маргааш уулзъя. (Goodbye, see you tomorrow.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. This is a departure farewell, not an arrival greeting.

exercises.correctAnswer: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу? (Good afternoon, are you well?)
acceptableAlternatives: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу?
Өдрийн мэнд, та сайн байна уу?
exercises.explanation: Mongolian communicative etiquette requires matching or elevating the politeness register of a diurnal greeting with 'Та сайн байна уу?'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Respectful and culturally authentic response.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Reply politely with: 'Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу?'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Addressing an equal or senior requires the polite 2nd-person pronoun 'Та' (never informal 'чи') in business and administrative settings.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу?
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Өдрийн мэнд хүргэе, та сайн байна уу?

exercises.exerciseTitle: Cloze Insertion: Evening Salutation
exercises.prompt: Fill in the blank with the correct genitive time word to complete the 19:00 PM greeting: '______ мэнд хүргэе!'.
exercises.hint: Recall how time-of-day nouns take the genitive attribute ending -н to modify 'мэнд' (wellbeing) for dusk hours.
exercises.correctAnswer: Оройн
exercises.explanation: 'Оройн мэнд хүргэе!' means 'Good evening!'. The noun 'орой' adds -н to form the genitive attribute 'оройн'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! 'Оройн мэнд хүргэе!' is complete.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use the genitive form of 'орой' (evening) ending in -н: 'Оройн'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Nouns ending in short diphthongs or vowels like 'орой' add '-н' to form the unstable genitive attribute ('оройн мэнд').

audio.speechSynthesisText: Оройн мэнд хүргэе!
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɔrɔiŋ mentʰ xʊrɡiː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Acoustic Salutation Decoding in Public Broadcast
exercises.prompt: Listen to the television news anchor opening the broadcast. At what time of day is this news program airing?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Эрхэм хүндэт үзэгчид ээ, энэ өдрийн амар амгаланг айлтган мэндчилье.
exercises.hint: Listen for 'энэ өдрийн' (of this day / afternoon).

options.text: Midday / Afternoon (Өдрийн цаг)
options.explanation: Correct! The anchor said 'энэ өдрийн амар амгалан' (peace of this day/afternoon).

options.text: Early Morning (Өглөөний цаг)
options.explanation: Incorrect. The anchor did not say өглөөний.

options.text: Late Night (Шөнийн цаг)
options.explanation: Incorrect. This is daytime broadcast greeting.

exercises.correctAnswer: Midday / Afternoon (Өдрийн цаг)
exercises.explanation: Anchors frequently use high-register ceremonial phrases like 'энэ өдрийн амар амгаланг айлтгая' for midday/afternoon transmissions.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! You caught 'энэ өдрийн' in formal broadcast speech.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The anchor said 'энэ өдрийн' which refers to the day/afternoon.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Амар амгаланг айлтгая' is a classical ceremonial formula deriving from traditional epistolary conventions.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Register Appropriateness: Casual vs Formal Greetings

options.text: Сайн уу, Батаа! (Hey, Bat!)

options.text: Юу байна даа? (What's cookin'?)

exercises.correctAnswer: Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе, захирал аа. (Good morning, Director.)

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Dignified and respectful executive communication.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use 'Өглөөний мэнд хүргэе, захирал аа.' for formal leadership.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The vocative enclitic 'аа/ээ/оо/өө' attached to titles ('захирал аа', 'багш аа') signals respectful direct address in administrative communication.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Reception Roleplay: Turn 1 Welcoming Inquiry
exercises.prompt: You step up to the reception desk. The receptionist smiles and says: 'Сайн байна уу? Танд юугаар туслах вэ?'. What should you say if you have an appointment with Mr. Bold?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Хүлээн авагч: Сайн байна уу? Танд юугаар туслах вэ?
exercises.hint: Use the comitative case '-тай' (with) when expressing meeting someone: Болдтой уулзах.

options.text: Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм. (Hello. I have come to meet Director Bold.)
options.cyrillic: Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм.
options.explanation: Correct! Natural and polite phrasing using intentional supine -хаар/хээр with comitative -тай.

options.text: Болд хаана байна? Би шууд орлоо. (Where is Bold? I'm going in directly.)
options.cyrillic: Болд хаана байна? Би шууд орлоо.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Impolite and violates visitor protocol.

options.text: Би захирал биш. (I am not a director.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Irrelevant response.

exercises.correctAnswer: Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм. (Hello. I have come to meet Director Bold.)
acceptableAlternatives: Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм.
exercises.explanation: '[Name]-тай уулзахаар ирсэн' (I have come in order to meet [Name]) is the standard polite formula at Mongolian office receptions.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! Polite and accurate visitor phrasing.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Say: 'Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм.'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The supine verbal noun in -хаар⁴ ('уулзахаар') denotes the deliberate purpose of arriving ('ирсэн').

audio.speechSynthesisText: Сайн байна уу. Би Болд захиралтай уулзахаар ирсэн юм.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Interpreting Polite Directives: 'Түр хүлээнэ үү'
exercises.prompt: The receptionist checks the register and says: 'За, та энд түр хүлээнэ үү. Би одоо мэдэгдье.' What did the receptionist ask you to do?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Хүлээн авагч: За, та энд түр хүлээнэ үү. Би одоо мэдэгдье.
exercises.hint: 'Түр' means 'temporarily/for a moment', and 'хүлээнэ үү' means 'please wait'.

options.text: Please wait here a moment while she notifies him.
options.explanation: Correct! 'Түр хүлээнэ үү' means 'please wait a moment'.

options.text: Please leave and come back next week.
options.explanation: Incorrect. She asked you to wait briefly.

options.text: Please call Director Bold on your phone right now.
options.explanation: Incorrect. She is notifying him herself.

exercises.correctAnswer: Please wait here a moment while she notifies him.
exercises.explanation: 'Түр хүлээнэ үү' is a polite request utilizing the volitional directive ending -нэ үү/нө үү ('will you please wait a moment').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! The receptionist asked you to wait briefly.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'Түр хүлээнэ үү' = Please wait a moment.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The polite request marker '-нэ үү/-нэ үү' attaches to verb stems to form soft directives appropriate in service interactions.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the receptionist give directions to the visitor: 'Болд захирлын өрөө 3-р давхарт, 305 тоот.' On which floor and in which room number is the meeting?
exercises.hint: 3-р давхар = 3rd floor; 305 тоот = room 305.

options.text: 3rd floor, Room 305 (3-р давхарт, 305 тоот)

exercises.exerciseTitle: Visitor Badge & Access Protocol Response

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Seamless professional visitor etiquette.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Respond with gratitude: 'Маш их баярлалаа, ойлголоо.'.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Instrumental Case Suffix Selection for Transport
exercises.prompt: Attach the correct harmonic allomorph of the instrumental case suffix (-аар/-ээр/-оор/-өөр) to the transport noun 'автобус' (bus):
exercises.correctAnswer: автобусаар
exercises.hint: Determine whether 'автобус' has masculine back or feminine front vowels, and attach the corresponding four-fold instrumental suffix without rounding.
exercises.explanation: Because 'автобус' ends in a consonant following back vowel 'у', it attaches the masculine unrounded instrumental suffix '-аар', yielding 'автобусаар' (by bus).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'автобусаар' is correct.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Back vowel 'у' takes '-аар' -> 'автобусаар'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The four-fold instrumental case suffix (-аар⁴) designates the means of transportation or instrument. Suffix vowel selection is governed by the vowel of the preceding syllable.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Би автобусаар явна.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰi awtʰɔpʊsaːr jawn/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Rounded Vowel Harmony in Instrumental: 'Онгоц'
exercises.prompt: How do you say 'by airplane' using the noun 'онгоц' and the instrumental case suffix?
exercises.hint: The root has vowel 'о', so the suffix must also be rounded 'оор'.

options.text: онгоцоор (by airplane)
options.explanation: Correct! Labial harmony dictates '-оор' after 'о'.

options.text: *онгоцаар
options.explanation: Incorrect. Violates rounding harmony (must be -оор after short 'о').

options.text: *онгоцоор
options.explanation: Incorrect. '-ээр' is front unrounded.

options.text: *онгоцөөр
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'өөр' is front rounded.

exercises.correctAnswer: онгоцоор (by airplane)
exercises.explanation: In Khalkha Mongolian, the non-high vowels 'о' and 'ө' enforce labial rounding harmony: after 'о', the suffix must be '-оор' ('онгоцоор').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! 'онгоцоор' follows labial rounding harmony.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: After 'о', use '-оор' -> 'онгоцоор'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Rounding harmony (уруулын зохицол) requires suffixes with non-high vowels (а, э, о, ө) to match the rounding of a preceding stem 'о' or 'ө'.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Бид Улаанбаатар руу онгоцоор ниссэн.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰitʰ ʊɮaːŋpaːtʰər rʊː ɔŋɢətsʰɔːr nissəŋ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Foot Transit vs Instrumental Vehicle Contrast
exercises.prompt: To say 'I go to work on foot (walking)', which form is grammatically correct in Mongolian?
exercises.hint: The adverbial 'явган' (on foot) does NOT take the instrumental suffix '-аар'.

options.text: Би явган явдаг. (I go on foot.)
options.explanation: Correct! 'Явган явах' is an idiomatic bare adverbial construction meaning 'to walk/go on foot'.

options.text: *Би явганаар явдаг.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Native speakers never attach the instrumental suffix to 'явган'.

options.text: *Би хөлөөрөө явдаг.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Literal 'by foot' is not standard transit phrasing.

exercises.correctAnswer: Би явган явдаг. (I go on foot.)
exercises.explanation: While vehicles take the instrumental case ('машинаар', 'автобусаар'), pedestrian transit is expressed with the bare root adverb 'явган' + verb.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'явган явах' takes no case suffix.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'явган' is used without '-аар': 'Би явган явдаг.'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Явган' functions as a Manner Adverbial directly preceding the motion verb without nominal case morphology.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Би өдөр бүр ажилдаа явган явдаг.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Би өдөр бүр ажилдаа явган явдаг.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰi ɵtər pʰur atʃʰiɮtʰaː jawɢəŋ jawtəɡ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Token Assembly: Daily Commute Description
exercises.prompt: Arrange the tokens to form: 'I go to my work by car':
exercises.correctAnswer: би ажилдаа машинаар явдаг
exercises.hint: Subject (би) -> Destination (ажилдаа) -> Means (машинаар) -> Verb (явдаг).
exercises.explanation: Canonical ordering places the directional goal and the instrumental means of transit before the habitual verb 'явдаг'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Proper word order with instrumental case 'машинаар'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Order: би -> ажилдаа -> машинаар -> явдаг.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Машинаар' attaches '-аар' to 'машин' (car). The reflex-possessive dative-locative 'ажилдаа' indicates 'to one's own work'.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Би ажилдаа машинаар явдаг.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰi atʃʰiɮtʰaː maʃiŋaːr jawtəɡ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Acoustic Transit Suffix Dictation
exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio sentence: 'Бид Дархан руу _______ явсан' (We went to Darkhan by train). Type the missing word for 'by train':
exercises.hint: Identify the two-word compound for 'train' and attach the appropriate front unrounded instrumental case ending with vowel syncope.
exercises.correctAnswer: галт тэргээр
exercises.explanation: 'Галт тэрэг' (train, literally 'fire vehicle') ends in front-vowel 'тэрэг', taking front unrounded instrumental '-ээр' -> 'галт тэргээр'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! 'галт тэргээр' spelled accurately.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember: 'галт тэрэг' takes front suffix -ээр with vowel syncope -> 'галт тэргээр'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Stems ending in 'г' preserve the consonant before the long vowel suffix: тэрэг + -ээр -> тэргээр (with short vowel syncope).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Бид Дархан руу галт тэргээр явсан.
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɢaɮtʰ tʰirɡeːr/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Extracting Operating Hours from Bus Stop Schedule
exercises.prompt:
Read the bus route timetable posted at a shelter in Ulaanbaatar:

[Ч:1 ЧИГЛЭЛ]
- Эхлэх цаг: 06:30
- Дуусах цаг: 22:30
- Хүлээх хугацаа: 8-12 минут

What is the earliest departure time (эхлэх цаг) for this route?
exercises.hint: 'Эхлэх' means 'to start / begin'.

options.explanation: Correct! 'Эхлэх цаг: 06:30' denotes start of service at 06:30.
Incorrect. 22:30 is the closing time (дуусах цаг).
Incorrect. 8-12 is the interval headway in minutes.

exercises.explanation: 'Эхлэх цаг' means departure start time. The schedule states 06:30.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 06:30 is the start time.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'Эхлэх цаг' = starting time (06:30).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Verbal nouns in -х ('эхлэх', 'дуусах', 'хүлээх') function as attributive nouns modifying 'цаг' (time) and 'хугацаа' (duration).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Энэ автобусны эхлэх цаг өглөө зургаан цаг гучин минут.
audio.ipaTranscription: /exɮəx tsʰaɡ tsʊrɢaːŋ tsʰaɡ ɢʊtsʰəŋ mʲinʊtʰ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Interpreting Bus Stop Headway & Wait Times
exercises.prompt: According to the sign: 'Хүлээх хугацаа: 8-12 минут' (Waiting duration: 8-12 minutes), how often does a bus arrive during normal operating hours?
exercises.hint: 'Хугацаа' means duration or interval.

options.text: Every 8 to 12 minutes
options.explanation: Correct! The bus frequency interval is between 8 and 12 minutes.

options.text: The entire trip takes only 8 minutes
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Хүлээх' means waiting, not traveling.

options.text: The bus is delayed by 12 hours
options.explanation: Incorrect. The text refers to minutes between buses.

exercises.correctAnswer: Every 8 to 12 minutes
exercises.explanation: 'Хүлээх хугацаа' indicates headway frequency between successive transit vehicles.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! You understood headway intervals.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'Хүлээх хугацаа' = waiting time (8-12 minutes).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Хүлээх' derives from the verb 'хүлээ-' (to wait). The suffix '-х' forms the future/habitual participle functioning here as an adjective.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Автобус хоорондын хүлээх хугацаа наймаас арван хоёр минут байна.
audio.ipaTranscription: /xʊɮiːx xʊɢatsʰaː næːmaːs arwəŋ xɔjər mʲinʊtʰ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: U-Money Electronic Card Notice Deciphering
exercises.prompt:
Read the red warning banner on the bus door:

'Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй. Та U-Money картаа заавал уншуулна уу.'

What does this notice instruct passengers to do?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй. Та U-Money картаа заавал уншуулна уу.
exercises.hint: 'Бэлэн мөнгө' is cash; 'уншуулах' means to tap/scan a card.

options.text: Cash is not accepted; you must tap your U-Money card.
options.explanation: Correct! Cash ('бэлэн мөнгө') is rejected and tapping the smart card is mandatory ('заавал').

options.text: You can pay with cash or card freely.
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй' means cash is NOT accepted.

options.text: Transit is completely free today.
options.explanation: Incorrect. You must pay via card.

exercises.correctAnswer: Cash is not accepted; you must tap your U-Money card.
acceptableAlternatives: Cash is not accepted; you must tap your U-Money card.
exercises.explanation: 'Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй' (No cash accepted). 'Та U-Money картаа заавал уншуулна уу' (Please be sure to scan your U-Money card).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Cashless bus transit rule understood.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Notice states: No cash accepted, tap your U-Money card.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Уншуулах' is the causative form of 'унших' (to read). In transit tech, it means 'to have the machine read / to tap' a card.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй. Та Ю-Мани картаа заавал уншуулна уу.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Бэлэн мөнгө авахгүй. Та Ю-Мани картаа заавал уншуулна уу.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pʰeɮəŋ mɵŋɡ əwəxɢuː. tʰa jʊː-manʲi xʰartʰaː tsaːwəɮ ʊŋʃʊːɮnə ʊː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Route Orientation: Eastbound vs Westbound Directions
exercises.prompt: You are at 'Сүхбаатарын талбай' and want to go towards the Officers' Palace (Офицеруудын ордон), which is located in the eastern part of Ulaanbaatar. Which platform direction should you board?
exercises.hint: 'Зүүн' means East; 'тийш' is the directive postposition ('towards').

options.text: Зүүн тийш явах чиглэл (Eastbound direction)
options.explanation: Correct! Officers' Palace is located in the East ('зүүн тийш').

options.text: Баруун тийш явах чиглэл (Westbound direction)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Баруун тийш' heads toward Dragon Terminal (Драгон) in the West.

options.text: Хойшоо явах чиглэл (Northbound direction)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Heading towards 7 Buudal in the North.

exercises.correctAnswer: Зүүн тийш явах чиглэл (Eastbound direction)
exercises.explanation: Ulaanbaatar main transit axes run East-West along Peace Avenue (Энхтайваны өргөн чөлөө). 'Зүүн тийш' means towards the East.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'Зүүн тийш' is eastbound.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: East is 'зүүн', so look for 'Зүүн тийш'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Direction in Mongolian combines the cardinal point noun with the directive postposition 'тийш/тийшээ' (towards).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Офицеруудын ордон руу зүүн тийш явах автобусанд сууна.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tsuːŋ tʰiːʃ jəwəx awtʰɔpʊs/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Transit Disruption Notice Reading Comprehension
exercises.prompt:
Read this municipal transit bulletin:

'Замын засварын ажилтай холбогдуулан 9-р сарын 25-ны өдөр Ч:5 чиглэлийн автобус Төв Шуудангийн зогсоолд түр зогсохгүй. Нарны замаар тойрч явна.'

Why will the Ch:5 bus bypass the Central Post Office stop today?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Замын засварын ажилтай холбогдуулан ... Төв Шуудангийн зогсоолд түр зогсохгүй.
exercises.hint: 'Замын засвар' means road repair.

options.text: Due to road repair work, it will detour via Sun Road and not stop at Central Post Office.
options.explanation: Correct! 'Замын засварын ажилтай холбогдуулан' = in connection with road repairs.

options.text: Scheduled route inspection: The line is undergoing scheduled mechanical testing and route audit.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The notice specifically states road repair work (замын засвар).

options.text: It is a national holiday and all buses are suspended.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Service is running but detouring.

exercises.correctAnswer: Due to road repair work, it will detour via Sun Road and not stop at Central Post Office.
exercises.explanation: 'Замын засвар' = road repair. The notice explains that Ch:5 will detour via Narны зам (Sun Road) without stopping at Central Post Office.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Complex municipal disruption notice decoded accurately.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The notice states the bus detours due to road repairs (замын засвар).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The chancellery postpositional phrase '-тай холбогдуулан' (in connection with / due to) governs nominalized cause phrases in administrative notices.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Замын засварын ажилтай холбогдуулан автобус Төв Шууданд зогсохгүй.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Замын засварын ажилтай холбогдуулан түр зогсохгүй.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tsamiːŋ tsaswəriːŋ atʃʰiɮtʰæː xɔɮpɔɢtʰʊːɮəŋ awtʰɔpʊs tʰɵw ʃʊːtəŋtʰ tsɔɡsɔxɢuː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Acoustic Dissection: Micro-Turn Commands in Cab
exercises.prompt:
Listen to the passenger giving a directional command to the taxi driver:

'Ах аа, энэ уулзвараар баруун гар тийшээ эргээрэй.'

Which direction did the passenger instruct the driver to turn?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Ах аа, энэ уулзвараар баруун гар тийшээ эргээрэй.
exercises.hint: 'Баруун гар тийшээ' = to the right hand side.

options.text: Turn right at this intersection (Баруун гар тийшээ)
options.explanation: Correct! 'Баруун' is right and 'эргээрэй' is please turn.

options.text: Turn left at this intersection (Зүүн гар тийшээ)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Left is 'зүүн гар тийшээ'.

options.text: Go straight through the intersection (Шулуун яваарай)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Straight is 'чигээрээ / шулуун'.

exercises.correctAnswer: Turn right at this intersection (Баруун гар тийшээ)
exercises.explanation: 'Баруун гар тийшээ эргээрэй' means 'Please turn right'. 'Уулзвараар' uses the instrumental case denoting passage through the intersection.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'Баруун' is right.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Listen for 'баруун гар тийшээ' (to the right).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: In Mongolian taxi parlance, addresses like 'Ах аа' (older brother / sir) are universally polite colloquial vocatives for male drivers.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Ах аа, энэ уулзвараар баруун гар тийшээ эргээрэй.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Энэ уулзвараар баруун гар тийшээ эргээрэй.
audio.ipaTranscription: /ax aː, en ʊːɮtswəraːr pʰarʊːŋ ɡar tʰiːʃeː erɡeːreː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Stop Command Relative to Traffic Light Threshold
exercises.prompt: Listen to the passenger instruction: 'Гэрлэн дохио өнгөрөөд замын хажууд зогсоорой.' Where should the driver pull over?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Гэрлэн дохио өнгөрөөд замын хажууд зогсоорой.
exercises.hint: 'Өнгөрөөд' means 'having passed / past', and 'замын хажууд' means 'at the side of the road'.

options.text: Right past the traffic light, on the side of the road.
options.explanation: Correct! Converb '-өөд' in 'өнгөрөөд' indicates action sequence: pass the light first, then stop roadside.

options.text: Before reaching the traffic light in the middle lane.
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Өнгөрөөд' means past the light.

options.text: Make a U-turn at the traffic light.
options.explanation: Incorrect. No U-turn requested.

exercises.correctAnswer: Right past the traffic light, on the side of the road.
exercises.explanation: 'Гэрлэн дохио' (traffic light) + 'өнгөрөөд' (having passed) + 'замын хажууд зогсоорой' (please stop at the roadside).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Accurate comprehension of motion converb 'өнгөрөөд'.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'Өнгөрөөд' means after passing the light.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The successive converb in -аад⁴ ('өнгөрөөд') expresses sequential action: after performing the first action, immediately execute the second.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Гэрлэн дохио өнгөрөөд замын хажууд зогсоорой.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Гэрлэн дохио өнгөрөөд замын хажууд зогсоорой.
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɡerɮəŋ tʰɔxʲɔː ɵŋɡɵrɵːtʰ tsamiːŋ xatʃʊːtʰ tsɔɡsɔːreː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Token Assembly: Straight Ahead Micro-Direction
exercises.prompt: Assemble the tokens to tell the driver: 'Cross the bridge and keep going straight':
exercises.correctAnswer: гүүр даваад шулуун яваарай
exercises.hint: Bridge (гүүр) -> having crossed (даваад) -> straight (шулуун) -> please go (яваарай).
exercises.explanation: Object noun + sequential converb 'даваад' precedes the manner adverb 'шулуун' and imperative 'яваарай'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! Natural navigation command formed.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Sequence: гүүр -> даваад -> шулуун -> яваарай.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Давах' means to cross over (a mountain pass, hill, or bridge). With converb '-аад', it coordinates the route action.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Гүүр даваад шулуун яваарай.
audio.ipaTranscription: /ɡuːr tʰawaːtʰ ʃʊɮʊːŋ jəwaːreː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Fare Negotiation Under Ambient Street Noise
exercises.prompt:
Listen to the street hail exchange through traffic noise:

Passenger: 'Багшийн дээд хүртэл явах уу?'
Driver: 'За суучих. Нэг километр нь хоёр мянган төгрөг шүү.'

What is the driver's rate per kilometer?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Нэг километр нь хоёр мянган төгрөг шүү.
exercises.hint: 2000 = хоёр мянга.

options.text: 2,000 MNT per kilometer
options.explanation: Correct! 'Хоёр мянган төгрөг' is 2,000 MNT.

options.text: 1,500 MNT per kilometer
options.explanation: Incorrect. Driver specified 2000 MNT.

options.text: 3,000 MNT flat rate
options.explanation: Incorrect. Rate is 2000 per km.

exercises.correctAnswer: 2,000 MNT per kilometer
exercises.explanation: The unofficial street taxi driver agreed to drive ('За суучих') and quoted 2,000 MNT per kilometer ('хоёр мянган төгрөг').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Street taxi fare extracted through noise.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Driver stated: 'Хоёр мянган төгрөг' = 2,000 MNT.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: In informal street hailing (гар өргөх), drivers state their per-kilometer rate followed by emphatic particle 'шүү' ('хоёр мянган төгрөг шүү').

audio.speechSynthesisText: За суучих. Нэг километр нь хоёр мянган төгрөг шүү.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Нэг километр нь хоёр мянган төгрөг шүү.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tsa sʊːtʃʰix. nʲeɡ xʲiɮɔmʲetʰər nʲ xɔjər mʲaŋɢəŋ tʰɵɡrɵɡ ʃuː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Cloze Insertion: Landmark-Relative Stop Instruction
exercises.prompt:
You want the driver to stop in front of the central Department Store (Их Дэлгүүр). Fill in the spatial postposition for 'in front of':

'Их Дэлгүүрийн ______ талд буулгаад өгөөрэй.'
exercises.hint: Consider the cardinal/spatial antonym of 'хойд' (back/north) commonly used in Mongolian urban directions for frontal location.
exercises.correctAnswer: урд
exercises.explanation: 'Урд талд' means 'in front of / on the south side'. Combined with 'буулгаад өгөөрэй' (please drop me off).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Гайхалтай! 'урд талд' is the precise spatial postposition.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Remember that 'урд талд' expresses 'in front of' (opposite of 'хойд талд').

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Postpositions of orientation (урд талд, ард талд, баруун талд, зүүн талд) systematically govern preceding nouns in the genitive case ('Их Дэлгүүрийн').

audio.speechSynthesisText: Их Дэлгүүрийн урд талд буулгаад өгөөрэй.
audio.slowSpeechSynthesisText: Их Дэлгүүрийн урд талд буулгаад өгөөрэй.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Deriving Abstract Noun from Verb Stem: -лга⁴
exercises.prompt: Derive the corporate abstract noun meaning 'responsibility / accountability' from the verb stem 'хариуц-' (to be in charge of / answer for) using the nominalizer suffix -лга⁴:
exercises.correctAnswer: хариуцлага
exercises.hint: The stem 'хариуц-' has back vowel 'у' in the root, so it attaches the back unrounded nominalizer suffix '-лага'.
exercises.explanation: Verb stem 'хариуц-' + nominalizer '-лага' yields the standard professional noun 'хариуцлага' (responsibility, accountability).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! 'хариуцлага' is the fundamental corporate concept of responsibility.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'хариуц-' + '-лага' = 'хариуцлага'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The productive deverbal nominalizer suffix -лга⁴ (-лага, -лэг, -лого, -лөгөө) transforms action verbs into institutional abstract concepts, processes, and corporate obligations.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Ажлын хариуцлага өндөр байх ёстой.
audio.ipaTranscription: /xarʲʊtsʰɮəɢ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Nominalizer -дал⁴ Application to Intransitive Stems
exercises.prompt: Which abstract noun is formed by attaching -дал⁴ to the copular verb stem 'бай-' (to be/exist)?
exercises.hint: Think of the common word for 'situation / state / condition'.

options.text: байдал (situation / state / condition)
options.explanation: Correct! 'бай-' + '-дал' -> 'байдал'.

options.text: байлга (act of maintaining / causing to be)
options.explanation: Incorrect. '-лга' yields action/causative noun, not stative condition.

options.text: байшил
options.explanation: Incorrect. Non-existent derivation.

exercises.correctAnswer: байдал (situation / state / condition)
exercises.explanation: 'Бай-' (to be) combines with nominalizer '-дал' to form 'байдал' (situation, condition, state of affairs).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Зөв! 'байдал' describes conditions and states.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: бай- + -дал = байдал.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Suffix -дал⁴ often attaches to stative and intransitive verbs to denote states of being or phenomena ('байдал' = condition, 'явдал' = conduct/affair, 'суудал' = seat/settlement).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Эдийн засгийн байдал тогтвортой байна.
audio.ipaTranscription: /pæːtəɮ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Syntactic Substitution: Converting Verb Clauses to Nominal Heads
exercises.prompt: Convert the verbal sentence 'Бид ирэх жил шинэ салбар нээхээр төлөвлөж байна' (We are planning to open a new branch next year) into a formal administrative noun phrase using 'төлөвлөгөө' (plan):
exercises.hint: 'Бидний төлөвлөгөө' (Our plan) replaces the verb.

options.text: Ирэх жил шинэ салбар нээх нь бидний төлөвлөгөөнд тусгагдсан. (Opening a new branch next year is reflected in our plan.)
options.explanation: Correct! Elegant conversion from verbal clause to formal institutional nominal structure.

options.text: *Бид нар төлөвлөдөг юм уу.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Casual colloquial question.

options.text: *Төлөвлөж байгаа бид.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Ungrammatical word order.

exercises.correctAnswer: Ирэх жил шинэ салбар нээх нь бидний төлөвлөгөөнд тусгагдсан. (Opening a new branch next year is reflected in our plan.)
acceptableAlternatives: Ирэх жил шинэ салбар нээх нь бидний төлөвлөгөөнд тусгагдсан.
exercises.explanation: Professional Mongolian chancellery style elevates clauses by replacing verbs with derived nominals ('төлөвлөх' -> 'төлөвлөгөөнд тусгагдах').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! Masterful transformation into formal institutional register.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Nominalize 'төлөвлөх' to 'төлөвлөгөө'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Deverbal abstract nouns readily take possessive and locative markers ('төлөвлөгөө-нд') to anchor passive and impersonal predicates in organizational reporting.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Ирэх жил шинэ салбар нээх нь бидний төлөвлөгөөнд тусгагдсан.
audio.ipaTranscription: /irəx tʃʰiɮ ʃinə saɮpər neːx nʲ pitniː tʰɵɮɵwɮɵɡɵːntʰ tʰʊsɢəɡtsʰəŋ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Semantic Discrimination: Action Verb vs Abstract Derivative
exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word to complete: 'Энэ төхөөрөмжийн хэвийн _________ хангаж ажиллах хэрэгтэй' (We must ensure the normal operation/functioning of this equipment):
exercises.hint: The adjective 'хэвийн' (normal) requires a nominal head meaning 'operation / functioning'.

options.text: ажиллагааг (operation / functioning - accusative noun)
options.explanation: Correct! 'Хэвийн ажиллагааг хангах' is the standard technical collocation for ensuring normal operation.

options.text: ажиллахыг (infinitive action)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Unnatural technical phrasing.

options.text: ажилчныг (worker)
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Worker' does not fit with 'хэвийн'.

exercises.correctAnswer: ажиллагааг (operation / functioning - accusative noun)
exercises.explanation: 'Ажиллах' (to work) derives 'ажиллагаа' (operation, process, action). In the accusative case with 'хангах' (to ensure/provide), it forms the idiomatic compound 'хэвийн ажиллагааг хангах'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'хэвийн ажиллагаа' is the standard operational term.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use derived noun: 'ажиллагааг'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Compound deverbal nouns in -лгаа⁴ ('үйл ажиллагаа' = operations, 'ажиллагаа' = function/operation) dominate workplace technical instructions.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Энэ төхөөрөмжийн хэвийн ажиллагааг хангаж ажиллах хэрэгтэй.
audio.ipaTranscription: /en tʰɵxɵːrɵmtʃʰiːŋ xewiːŋ atʃʰiɮɮaɢaːɡ xaŋɢətʃʰ atʃʰiɮɮəx xirəkʰtʰeː/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Token Assembly: Workplace Policy Statement with Multiple Derived Nominals
exercises.prompt: Reconstruct this organizational motto: 'Cooperation is the foundation of success':
exercises.correctAnswer: хамтын ажиллагаа амжилтын үндэс мөн
exercises.hint: Cooperation (хамтын ажиллагаа) -> of success (амжилтын) -> foundation (үндэс) -> is (мөн).
exercises.explanation: 'Хамтын ажиллагаа' (cooperation) + 'амжилтын үндэс мөн' (is indeed the foundation of success). Both 'ажиллагаа' and 'амжилт' are derived abstract nouns.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! Exemplary professional motto assembled.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Order: хамтын -> ажиллагаа -> амжилтын -> үндэс -> мөн.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Мөн' at the end of nominal equative clauses acts as an emphatic copula in formal administrative and philosophical statements.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Хамтын ажиллагаа амжилтын үндэс мөн.
audio.ipaTranscription: /xamtʰiːŋ atʃʰiɮɮaɢaː amtʃʰiɮtʰiːŋ untəs mɵŋ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Distinguishing 'Мэргэжил' (Profession) vs 'Мэргэшил' (Specialization)
exercises.prompt: In formal Mongolian human resources terminology, what is the crucial distinction between 'мэргэжил' and 'мэргэшил'?
exercises.hint: 'Мэргэжил' is your broad baseline profession; 'мэргэшил' is specialized postgraduate or practical qualification.

options.text: 'Мэргэжил' denotes basic occupation/profession (e.g. эмч - physician); 'мэргэшил' denotes sub-specialization or advanced credential (e.g. зүрхний эмч - cardiologist).
options.cyrillic: мэргэжил бол мэргэжлийн үндэс, мэргэшил бол нарийн мэргэшлийн зэрэг
options.explanation: Correct! 'Мэргэжил' is occupation/trade, while 'мэргэшил' is professional specialization/qualification.

options.text: They are completely interchangeable synonyms with no legal or HR difference.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Mongolian Civil Service and labor codes strictly differentiate them.

options.text: 'Мэргэшил' means hobby or extracurricular interest.
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Мэргэшил' is an official credential.

exercises.correctAnswer: 'Мэргэжил' denotes basic occupation/profession (e.g. эмч - physician); 'мэргэшил' denotes sub-specialization or advanced credential (e.g. зүрхний эмч - cardiologist).
exercises.explanation: 'Мэргэжил' = profession/occupation obtained via initial diploma. 'Мэргэшил' = specialization, continuous professional advancement, or specific qualification accreditation.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! Essential distinction for HR and CV writing.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Мэргэжил = profession; Мэргэшил = specialization/qualification.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Deverbal noun 'мэргэшил' derives from the verb 'мэргэших' (to become specialized/expert in a field).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Миний үндсэн мэргэжил инженер, нарийн мэргэшил нь мэдээллийн аюулгүй байдал.
audio.ipaTranscription: /mʲinʲiː untsəŋ merɡətʃʰiɮ intʃʰineːr, nareːŋ merɡətʃʰiɮ nʲ metiːɮɮiːŋ ajʊːɮɡuː pæːtəɮ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: HR Collocation Pairing: Verbs to Competency Nouns
exercises.prompt: Which verb naturally pairs with 'туршлага' (experience) to mean 'to accumulate / gain professional experience'?
exercises.hint: Look for the verb derived from 'хуримтлал' (accumulation).

options.text: хуримтлуулах (to accumulate / build up)
options.explanation: Correct! 'Туршлага хуримтлуулах' is the standard, elegant corporate collocation.

options.text: худалдан авах (to purchase)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Experience cannot be bought with 'худалдан авах'.

options.text: гээх (to lose/drop)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Means to lose.

exercises.correctAnswer: хуримтлуулах (to accumulate / build up)
exercises.explanation: 'Ажлын туршлага хуримтлуулах' (to accumulate work experience) is the authoritative collocation across resume descriptions.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'туршлага хуримтлуулах' is the authentic professional collocation.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Pair 'туршлага' with 'хуримтлуулах'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Хуримтлуулах' is a causative verb from 'хуримтлах' (to accumulate, amass), widely used in educational and corporate discourse.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Тэрээр санхүүгийн салбарт арван жилийн туршлага хуримтлуулсан.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tʰereːr saŋxuːɡiːŋ saɮpərtʰ arwəŋ tʃʰiɮiːŋ tʰʊrʃɮəɢ xʊrʲimtʰɮʊːɮsəŋ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Deciphering Job Vacancy Minimum Criteria
exercises.prompt:
Read the following extract from an Ulaanbaatar corporate job posting:

'ТАВИГДАХ ШААРДЛАГА:
- Бизнесийн удирдлага, эдийн засгийн чиглэлээр бакалавр болон түүнээс дээш зэрэгтэй байх
- Мэргэжлээрээ 3-аас доошгүй жил ажилласан туршлагатай байх
- Англи хэлний ахисан түвшний мэдлэгтэй байх'

What is the minimum work experience required in the candidate's field?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Мэргэжлээрээ 3-аас доошгүй жил ажилласан туршлагатай байх
exercises.hint: '3-аас доошгүй' means 'not less than 3 / at least 3'.

options.text: At least 3 years of work experience in the profession (3-аас доошгүй жил)
options.explanation: Correct! '3-аас доошгүй' = minimum of 3 years.

options.text: Maximum 3 years of experience
options.explanation: Incorrect. 'Доошгүй' means not less than.

options.text: No previous experience required
options.explanation: Incorrect. Experience is mandatory.

exercises.correctAnswer: At least 3 years of work experience in the profession (3-аас доошгүй жил)
exercises.explanation: '3-аас доошгүй' combines ablative case '-аас' with postposition 'доош' and negative caritive '-гүй' to denote 'not lower than 3 / minimum 3'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! Accurate decoding of legal HR criteria.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: '3-аас доошгүй' = at least 3 years.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Standard administrative threshold criteria utilize the formula '[Num]-аас доошгүй' (minimum) and '[Num]-аас дээшгүй' (maximum).

audio.speechSynthesisText: Мэргэжлээрээ гурваас доошгүй жил ажилласан туршлагатай байх шаардлагатай.
audio.ipaTranscription: /merɡətʃʰɮeːreː ɢʊrwaːs tʰɔːʃɢuː tʃʰiɮ atʃʰiɮɮəsəŋ tʰʊrʃɮəɢtʰæː pæːx ʃaːrtɮəɢtʰaː/

options.text: Багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай (Possessing high teamwork and communication competencies)
options.cyrillic: Багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай

options.text: Хүмүүстэй сайн ярьж, найзалдаг (Talks well and makes friends with folks)

exercises.correctAnswer: Багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай (Possessing high teamwork and communication competencies)
acceptableAlternatives: Багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай
exercises.explanation: Professional CVs utilize compound nominals with comitative/possessive adjectival suffixes: 'багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! High-register professional soft skill description.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use: 'Багаар ажиллах болон харилцааны өндөр ур чадвартай'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The adjectival suffix '-тай/-тэй⁴' acts productively to create predicate descriptors ('ур чадвартай' = competent, skilled).

exercises.hint: Personal info comes first, followed by education, work history, and competencies.
exercises.explanation: Standard Mongolian professional resume (товч намтар) architecture progresses logically: 1. Хувийн мэдээлэл (Personal Info) -> 2. Боловсрол (Education) -> 3. Ажлын туршлага (Experience) -> 4. Ур чадвар (Skills).

exercises.exerciseTitle: Register Elevation in Action Bullet Points
exercises.prompt: A candidate drafted this conversational draft for their resume: 'Би 5 хүнийг хариуцаж ажилласан' (I worked taking care of 5 people). Which option elevates this into a formal, high-impact bullet point?
exercises.hint: Use formal participial phrasing: 'удирдан зохион байгуулсан' (managed and organized).

options.text: 5 хүний бүрэлдэхүүнтэй төслийн багийг удирдан зохион байгуулж, төлөвлөгөөт ажлыг амжилттай хэрэгжүүлсэн. (Organized and led a 5-person project team, successfully implementing planned targets.)
options.explanation: Correct! Replaces conversational 'хариуцаж ажилласан' with professional compound verbs 'удирдан зохион байгуулж... хэрэгжүүлсэн'.

options.text: Би дарга байсан, 5 хүн миний дор ажилласан. (I was boss, 5 people worked under me.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Egocentric and colloquial.

options.text: 5 хүн ажиллаж байхыг харсан. (Watched 5 people working.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Passive observation, not achievement.

exercises.correctAnswer: 5 хүний бүрэлдэхүүнтэй төслийн багийг удирдан зохион байгуулж, төлөвлөгөөт ажлыг амжилттай хэрэгжүүлсэн. (Organized and led a 5-person project team, successfully implementing planned targets.)
acceptableAlternatives: 5 хүний бүрэлдэхүүнтэй төслийн багийг удирдан зохион байгуулсан
exercises.explanation: Professional Mongolian CV bullet points utilize compound modal converbs with perfective past participles: 'удирдан зохион байгуулж... амжилттай хэрэгжүүлсэн'.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! High-impact corporate leadership articulation.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Elevate with: '5 хүний бүрэлдэхүүнтэй төслийн багийг удирдан зохион байгуулж... хэрэгжүүлсэн.'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The modal converb in -н ('удирдан') joins seamlessly with secondary transitive verbs ('зохион байгуулах') to form elegant elevated verb chains.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Таван хүний бүрэлдэхүүнтэй төслийн багийг удирдан зохион байгуулж, амжилттай хэрэгжүүлсэн.
audio.ipaTranscription: /tʰawəŋ xuniː pʊreɮtəxuːntʰeː tʰɵsɮiːŋ pʰaɡiːɡ ʊtirtəŋ tsɔxʲɔŋ pæːɢʊːɮtʃʰ, amtʃʰiɮtʰtʰæː xirəkʰtʃuːɮsəŋ/

exercises.exerciseTitle: Composing Career Objective Statement (Зорилго)
exercises.prompt: Which career objective statement (Зорилго) best demonstrates mutual value creation for an applicant seeking a financial analyst position?
exercises.hint: Balance personal growth with institutional contribution ('байгууллагын хөгжилд хувь нэмэр оруулах').

options.text: Өөрийн мэдлэг, ур чадвараа дайчлан санхүүгийн шинжилгээний чиглэлээр тасралтгүй хөгжиж, байгууллагын үйл ажиллагаанд бодитой хувь нэмэр оруулах. (To deploy my knowledge and competencies to continuously develop in financial analysis, making a tangible contribution to organizational operations.)
options.cyrillic: байгууллагын үйл ажиллагаанд бодитой хувь нэмэр оруулах
options.explanation: Correct! Exemplary career objective balancing dedication ('дайчлан'), growth ('хөгжиж'), and institutional impact ('хувь нэмэр оруулах').

options.text: Өндөр цалинтай ажилд орж, туршлага олж авах. (To get a high-paying job and get experience.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Blunt, mercenary, and unacceptable in formal profiles.

options.text: Ямар нэгэн ажил олж хийхийг хүсэж байна. (Wanting to find some work to do.)
options.explanation: Incorrect. Vague and passive.

exercises.correctAnswer: Өөрийн мэдлэг, ур чадвараа дайчлан санхүүгийн шинжилгээний чиглэлээр тасралтгүй хөгжиж, байгууллагын үйл ажиллагаанд бодитой хувь нэмэр оруулах. (To deploy my knowledge and competencies to continuously develop in financial analysis, making a tangible contribution to organizational operations.)
acceptableAlternatives: байгууллагын үйл ажиллагаанд бодитой хувь нэмэр оруулах
exercises.explanation: A professional Mongolian career summary highlights: 1. Deploying capability ('дайчлан') + 2. Organizational contribution ('байгууллагын хөгжилд хувь нэмэр оруулах').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! Balanced and persuasive career objective.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Focus on institutional contribution: 'хувь нэмэр оруулах'.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: 'Хувь нэмэр оруулах' (literally 'to introduce a share and addition') is the universal idiomatic expression for 'to contribute to a collective goal'.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Өөрийн ур чадвараа дайчлан, байгууллагын хөгжилд бодитой хувь нэмэр оруулах.

exercises.hint: Apply the rounded front-vowel past participle suffix (-сөн) to the verbal stem for completing/graduating.
exercises.correctAnswer: төгссөн
exercises.explanation: 'Төгссөн' (graduated) is the standard terminal participle for educational history entries in Mongolian CVs.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! 'төгссөн' is the exact credential verb.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use the past participle form of 'төгсөх' (-сөн) to mark educational completion.

exercises.exerciseTitle: CV Section Rubric Evaluation
exercises.prompt:
Evaluate this draft CV work experience excerpt against institutional standards:

'2021-2023 он: "Номин Холдинг" ХХК-д Маркетингийн менежер.
- Компанийн шинэ бүтээгдэхүүний зах зээлийн судалгааг удирдан хийсэн.
- Борлуулалтын хэмжээг 15 хувиар өсгөсөн.
- Багийн 4 гишүүнийг өдөр тутмын үйл ажиллагаагаар чиглүүлсэн.'

Explain whether this excerpt meets professional standards for: 1. Action verbs, 2. Quantified results, 3. Grammatical accuracy.
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: 2021-2023 он: Маркетингийн менежер ... Борлуулалтын хэмжээг 15 хувиар өсгөсөн.
exercises.correctAnswer: Meets professional standards with clear elevated action verbs (удирдан хийсэн, өсгөсөн, чиглүүлсэн), measurable outcome (15 хувиар өсгөсөн), and correct casing.
exercises.hint: Notice whether verbs are elevated and whether measurable outcomes (15%) are included.
exercises.explanation: The excerpt successfully satisfies professional CV criteria: elevated deverbal participles, quantified commercial achievement (15% growth), and accurate casing (ХХК-д, судалгааг).

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Төгс! You evaluated the CV entry with critical professional acuity.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Check if the entry contains elevated action verbs and quantified impact.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Modern Mongolian business CVs emphasize concrete results ('үр дүн') expressed via quantified instrumental percentages ('15 хувиар').

audio.speechSynthesisText: Энэхүү товч намтрын хэсэг нь мэргэжлийн шаардлагад бүрэн нийцсэн байна.

lessons.title: Hearsay Evidentiality: Distinguishing Гэнэ (They Say) vs Сурагтай (Rumored)
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Communicate reported information, relay news, and report unverified gossip without claiming direct personal eyewitness authority.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce the B1 hearsay evidentiality system: 1) Quotative/hearsay particle гэнэ (reporting second-hand information, rumors, or unverified claims: маргааш цас орно гэнэ, тэр их сайн ажилладаг гэнэ), and 2) Inferential hearsay/news particle сурагтай (distant rumor or widespread hearsay: хөдөө өвөлжилт хүндрэх сурагтай, шинэ төсөл эхлэх сурагтай).
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Communicate reported information, relay news, and report unverified gossip without claiming direct personal eyewitness authority.
lessons.audioPurpose: Demonstrate the sentence-final descending intonation of гэнэ and сурагтай.

lessons.primaryPurpose: Master the three-way evidential contrast fundamental to Mongolian epistemology: 1) Direct personal observation (-лаа/-лоо/-в), 2) Post-facto perceptual deduction (-жээ/-чээ, бололтой), and 3) Second-hand reported hearsay (гэнэ, сурагтай, сураг дуулдсан).

exercises.exerciseTitle: Acoustic Dissection: Identifying Interpellation Thrust
exercises.prompt:
Listen to the Member of Parliament addressing the Minister of Finance during question time:

'Улсын төсвийн тодотголд тусгагдсан нийтийн тээврийн парк шинэчлэлийн хөрөнгө оруулалт бодит байдал дээр ямар үр дүнд хүрсэн бэ? Энэ талаар холбогдох сайд тодорхой тайлбар өгнө үү.'

What is the primary thrust of the MP's interpellation?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Улсын төсвийн тодотголд тусгагдсан нийтийн тээврийн парк шинэчлэлийн хөрөнгө оруулалт бодит байдал дээр ямар үр дүнд хүрсэн бэ?
exercises.hint: Focus on 'төсвийн тодотгол' (budget amendment) and 'бодит үр дүн' (actual tangible results).

options.text: Demanding accountability and concrete evidence on how budget funds for public transit fleet modernization were spent.
options.cyrillic: Нийтийн тээврийн төсвийн бодит үр дүнг шаардах
options.explanation: Correct! The MP questions the tangible return on investment from public transit budget allocations.

options.text: Formally congratulating the minister on completing the transit modernization ahead of schedule.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The tone is interrogative and skeptical.

options.text: Proposing that transit funding be canceled altogether.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The MP is pressing for implementation results, not cancellation.

exercises.correctAnswer: Demanding accountability and concrete evidence on how budget funds for public transit fleet modernization were spent.
acceptableAlternatives: Demanding accountability on transit budget spending
exercises.explanation: Parliamentary interpellation (асуулга) uses polite chancellery syntax ('тодорхой тайлбар өгнө үү') to demand rigorous executive accountability regarding public expenditures.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! Sharp political acoustic decoding.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: The MP is pressing the minister on the real results of the transit budget.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Interpellation syntax in the State Great Khural (УИХ) relies on relative participial heads ('төсвийн тодотголд тусгагдсан хөрөнгө оруулалт') followed by an open interrogative ('ямар үр дүнд хүрсэн бэ').

exercises.exerciseTitle: Diplomatic Courtesy vs Underlying Acoustic Tension
exercises.prompt:
Listen to the committee chair's remark to a testifying official:

'Эрхэм сайдын илтгэлийг сонслоо. Гэвч энэ удаагийн танилцуулсан тоо баримт нь өмнөх сарын Аудитын тайлантай илтэд зөрчилдөж байгааг юу гэж ойлгох вэ?'

Behind the formal honorific 'Эрхэм сайд' (Honorable Minister), what subtext is the speaker conveying?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Гэвч энэ удаагийн танилцуулсан тоо баримт нь өмнөх сарын Аудитын тайлантай илтэд зөрчилдөж байгааг юу гэж ойлгох вэ?
exercises.hint: 'Илтэд зөрчилдөх' means 'to blatantly contradict'.

options.text: Direct skepticism: The minister's reported numbers directly contradict the independent Audit Report, implying potential dishonesty or gross mismanagement.
options.cyrillic: Тоо баримт аудитын тайлантай зөрчилдөж буйг шүүмжлэх
options.explanation: Correct! Blatant contradiction ('илтэд зөрчилдөх') between ministry figures and official audit reports signals severe parliamentary distrust.

options.text: Unreserved agreement and endorsement of the ministry's financial management.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The speaker explicitly flags severe discrepancies.

options.text: Granting the minister an exemption from submitting further accounting documentation.
options.explanation: Incorrect. The speaker is holding the minister to account.

exercises.correctAnswer: Direct skepticism: The minister's reported numbers directly contradict the independent Audit Report, implying potential dishonesty or gross mismanagement.
exercises.explanation: High-register Mongolian parliamentary discourse wraps sharp evidentiary contradictions in strictly polite chancellery phrasing ('сонслоо... гэвч... юу гэж ойлгох вэ').

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Яг зөв! You detected the underlying legislative confrontation beneath the diplomatic polish.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: Notice the phrase 'илтэд зөрчилдөж байгааг' (blatantly contradicting).

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: The rhetorical interrogative 'юу гэж ойлгох вэ?' (how are we to understand this?) serves as a conventionalized vehicle for aggressive institutional challenge in Khural debates.

audio.speechSynthesisText: Эрхэм сайдын илтгэлийг сонслоо. Гэвч энэ удаагийн танилцуулсан тоо баримт нь өмнөх сарын Аудитын тайлантай илтэд зөрчилдөж байгааг юу гэж ойлгох вэ?

exercises.exerciseTitle: Rhetorical Discourse Markers in High-Speed Legislative Debate
exercises.prompt:
Listen to the MP transition between macro-policy and immediate fiscal repercussions:

'Хуулийн үзэл баримтлал нь зөв боловч, бодит байдал дээр иргэдийн амьжиргаанд хүндээр тусаж байна. Үүнтэй холбогдуулан бид гурван асуудлыг нэн даруй шийдвэрлэх шаардлагатай.'

What discourse function does the phrase 'Үүнтэй холбогдуулан' perform?
exercises.stimulusTextCyrillic: Үүнтэй холбогдуулан бид гурван асуудлыг нэн даруй шийдвэрлэх шаардлагатай.
exercises.hint: 'Үүнтэй холбогдуулан' means 'In connection with this / Accordingly'.

options.text: Logical transition: Connecting the stated practical problem to immediate concrete policy proposals.
options.explanation: Correct! It links the preceding critique to an actionable agenda.

options.text: Rejecting the previous sentence as false and irrelevant.
options.explanation: Incorrect. It builds upon, rather than refutes, the prior clause.

options.text: Signaling the conclusion of the speech and bidding farewell.
options.explanation: Incorrect. It introduces three upcoming substantive proposals.

exercises.correctAnswer: Logical transition: Connecting the stated practical problem to immediate concrete policy proposals.
exercises.explanation: 'Үүнтэй холбогдуулан' (literally: 'having connected with this') is the preeminent formal connective phrase bridging diagnosis to programmatic intervention.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Сайн байна! 'Үүнтэй холбогдуулан' guides parliamentary rhetoric flawlessly.

exercises.exerciseTitle: Functional Contrast: Thematic 'Бол' vs Adversative 'Харин'
exercises.prompt: In academic and political Mongolian, what is the precise syntactic and pragmatic difference between the discourse particles 'бол' and 'харин'?
exercises.hint: 'Бол' introduces or grounds the theme; 'харин' pivots to introduce a sharp contrasting argument.

options.text: 'Бол' marks the established topic / baseline theme (As for X...); 'харин' introduces a contrastive topic or adversative shift (Whereas Y / On the other hand, Y...).
options.cyrillic: бол бол сэдэв заах, харин бол эсрэгцүүлэн тодотгох
options.explanation: Correct! 'Бол' establishes the frame of reference; 'харин' introduces the contrasting counterpart.

options.text: 'Бол' is only used in colloquial slang, while 'харин' is only used in ancient poetry.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Both are vital across all modern registers.

options.text: 'Бол' is a past tense suffix, while 'харин' is a question particle.
options.explanation: Incorrect. Neither is a verbal tense suffix.

exercises.correctAnswer: 'Бол' marks the established topic / baseline theme (As for X...); 'харин' introduces a contrastive topic or adversative shift (Whereas Y / On the other hand, Y...).
acceptableAlternatives: бол marks topic, харин marks contrastive topic
exercises.explanation: 'Бол' marks the topical ground of a proposition, while 'харин' serves as a contrastive discourse marker setting up an antithetical balance.

learnerFeedback.onSuccess: Маш сайн! Masterful grasp of Mongolian information packaging.
learnerFeedback.onFailure: 'Бол' establishes the theme; 'харин' creates the contrast.

exercises.detailedGrammarNote: Originating from conditional converb 'болбол' (if it becomes), 'бол' grammaticalized into a universal topic marker. 'Харин' functions as a sentential conjunction marking contrastive focus.

options.text: бол / харин ('...орлого бол нэмэгдсэн, харин иргэдийн...')
options.explanation: Correct! 'Орлого бол' frames the mining revenue; 'харин иргэдийн' pivots to the contrasting decline in household income.

options.text: бол / бол

exercises.explanation: Canonical contrastive structure: Topic Clause (X бол...) followed by Contrast Clause (харин Y...).

learnerFeedback.onFailure: Use 'бол' in the first clause and 'харин' in the second.
